name: Aotsuki Kouya
source:
Kouya is normally calm, but he can get mad quickly. He also is sort of stubborn. He lives by himself at home after separating from his parents, graduating middle school, and makes a living by working. Kouya is also part of a band.

[From [url=http://en.wikifur.com/wiki/Morenatsu]Wikifur[/url]]
